title: Hidden lines around solids (ln)
description: The ln engine ray-tests surface lines against solids and projects the visible segments. Three camera views are computed locally.
description_ko: ln 엔진으로 표면의 선과 입체의 가림 관계를 검사했어요. 보이는 선만 투영한 세 시점을 직접 계산했어요.
prompt: Hidden lines around solids. Recompute with the included Go recipe when changing inputs.
made_with: Go 1.25.10; pinned modules in go.mod/go.sum; executed locally on macOS arm64

tool_about: The ln engine ray-tests surface lines against solids and projects the visible segments. Three camera views are computed locally. Viewing reads locally computed outputs; the recipe runs the original tool.
